name: DRLVaultV3
fix_description: swapToWETH is public without access control, while swapAllToWETH has onlyOwner. Anyone can call swapToWETH to force the vault to swap at a manipulated price. Fix: add onlyOwner modifier to swapToWETH. Additionally, getQuoteForUSDC may use spot price for slippage calculation which can also be manipulated — consider using a TWAP-based quote.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is a multi-step DeFi attack involving a flash loan, token purchase, liquidity addition to qualify for rewards, mass deployment of helper contracts via CREATE2, repeated airdrop claims, and then liquidity removal plus unwinding. It requires understanding protocol-specific airdrop logic and LP accounting abuse, but the PoC itself is still fairly direct and not deeply intricate.
